versions.changelog:
No functional changes in this release.

- Documentation updated: small improvement to referral upload information in the Notes section.
- No changes to code or logic detected.

- Updated brand coverage to over 10,000 brands (previously 9,000+).
- Expanded examples and supported query types in user guidance.
- Clarified instructions for link-based (direct clicking) and code-based (where to enter the code) referrals.
- Added extra informational resources and integration/contact options in the notes.
- Users are now informed about sharing their own referral codes and bulk uploading via relevant site links.

Initial release of ReferralCodes Referral & Referrals Finder.

- Provides up to 3 live, verified referral links or codes for over 9,000 brands
- Prioritizes the best available offer and shows offer details.
- Supports requests for referral links, invites, signup bonuses and referral rewards by brand.
- Clearly indicates when no offers are available.
